description: OpenCode Desktop inbox for tasks that OpenClaw (or any script) dispatches with `opencode run --archived`: a quiet badge in the session header, a macOS menubar item, one-click open, and auto-unarchive when you take a task over.

detail.description_zh: OpenCode Desktop 收件箱用于接收 OpenClaw（或任何脚本）使用 `opencode run --archived` 分发的任务：会话标题中的静默徽章、macOS 菜单栏项、单击即可打开，以及在接手任务时自动解压归档。
